lessons.key: gate_fail::use timezone aware datetime date constructors consistently across a whole diff datetime now utc date fromisoformat a single leftover naive datetime strptime or date today call trips ruff dtz rules and fails the mandatory build gate
lessons.text: Use timezone-aware datetime/date constructors consistently across a whole diff (datetime.now(UTC), date.fromisoformat) - a single leftover naive datetime.strptime or date.today() call trips ruff DTZ rules and fails the mandatory Build gate.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a spec required review audit queue is implemented as in memory only state treat it as unresolved until a persistence decision is made since in memory state does not survive process restarts or become visible to downstream consumers
lessons.text: When a spec-required review/audit queue is implemented as in-memory-only state, treat it as unresolved until a persistence decision is made, since in-memory state does not survive process restarts or become visible to downstream consumers.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a calculation formula branches on a domain value not yet confirmed by the real data source add a test case that forces the ambiguous branch to diverge from the default path so the documented assumption is provably implemented and not just described in a comment
lessons.text: When a calculation formula branches on a domain value not yet confirmed by the real data source, add a test case that forces the ambiguous branch to diverge from the default path, so the documented assumption is provably implemented and not just described in a comment.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an edge case has a unit test at the domain layer add the equivalent integration route level test too since unit coverage does not guarantee the http layer wires the same error path correctly
lessons.text: When an edge case has a unit test at the domain layer, add the equivalent integration/route-level test too, since unit coverage does not guarantee the HTTP layer wires the same error path correctly.
